Thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you've requested. Quick plan / clarifications:

1) SAML assertion sample — we will produce a sanitized XML assertion captured from a recent production login. We will redact user-identifying values (replace with placeholders) but keep attribute names, NameID format, assertion timestamps, signatures, and attribute formats intact. We will NOT include private keys or raw IdP certificate material.

2) SCIM delta export — we'll provide a CSV covering 2026-08-07 through 2026-09-07 that contains: operation (add/update/remove), resourceType (User/Group), resourceId, attributes changed, timestamp (UTC), and actor (if available). If actor is not present for a particular change we will note that in the README.

3) README — a short mapping file that shows: IdP group -> Redwood role, idempotency handling for SCIM, and treatment of service accounts.

Delivery method: we'll upload artifacts to a presigned S3 bucket and share the links with time-limited access. If you prefer Drive, call out which Google account you will use for access.

Open question: you mentioned "SSO login logs" — we can produce an excerpt of successful SSO events (timestamp, principal, assertion_id) for the period, but we treat full login logs as higher-sensitivity; we will provide a minimal extract unless you require broader detail and sign an additional NDA.

I'll coordinate with Marissa to assemble the exports and Karthik on the SCIM delta extraction. Expect a deliverable tomorrow (2026-09-08) with the sample assertion and SCIM CSV.

- For role mapping, see ROLE_MAP.md in the Drive folder (link below). Short summary: IdP group "infra-admins" -> Redwood role "platform_admin"; IdP group "svc-*" -> "service_account" (restricted).
